description: Lock account after N failed authentication attempts. Protects against brute force attacks with configurable lockout duration.

parameters.preauth: Check for locked status before authentication
parameters.authsucc: Record successful attempt and clear failures
parameters.deny: Number of failed attempts before lockout (default: 5)

parameter_help.preauth: Check if account is locked BEFORE attempting auth. If locked, fail immediately.
parameter_help.authfail: Record failed auth attempt to faillock database
parameter_help.authsucc: Clear failed attempts on successful auth
parameter_help.deny: Lock account after N failed attempts
parameter_help.fail_interval: Consider only failures within last N seconds
parameter_help.unlock_time: Keep account locked for N seconds

notes: CRITICAL for security. Essential on any login interface. Always use with preauth and authfail/authsucc structure.
